definitions.explanation: Asks or refers to an unspecified number of people. Slightly formal or literary; in casual speech, {何人|なんにん} is far more common.

examples.japanese: {幾人|いくにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧そう⟦{述|の}べている→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
{幾人|いくにん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{幾人|いくにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: His paper has been cited by many researchers up to now.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{幾|いく}→幾〜：00444_iku⟧ (how many; some) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (people). Most often appears in {幾人|いくにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (many people) and {幾人|いくにん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (several people). Has a literary feel; use ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧ in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幾人|いくにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: many people; a great number of people
- {幾人|いくにん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: several people; a few people
- {幾人|いくにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧の〜: many ~ (with a following noun phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧: how many people — everyday standard form
- ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧: several people — neutral, common in writing
- ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧: a crowd; many people
